Fully and opaquely clothed in a high-neck teal blouse, charcoal trousers, leather apron, and closed oxford shoes, she pauses mid-restoration to inspect a burnished sunburst veneer panel. She visibly realizes a perched edge-sit with grounded support, crossed ankles forming a narrow believable base, and a relaxed wrist offset. Her pelvis contacts the tool chest's front edge and her left palm braces beside her hip. One sole plants on parquet; the other forefoot touches down beyond visibly crossed ankles; both shoes stay distinct. Her free right wrist drapes softly outward from the forearm, with intact joint continuity and loose fingers. Use a vertical 4:5 composition at seated hip height, keeping chest edge, ankles, feet, and wrist clear. Task light reveals support contacts; cool dawn light outlines opaque clothing, veneer, leather, walnut, and brass.
